prompt: Complete a static paint method that draws the same three points twice: once as a solid fillPolygon and once as an open, thick drawPolyline, so the difference between the two is visible.
explanation: fillPolygon treats the point list as a closed outline and paints its interior, while drawPolyline treats the same list as an open path and only strokes the segments between consecutive points -- there is no segment from the last point back to the first. Because the polyline is only stroked, its interior keeps the background colour. The thick BasicStroke makes the stroked path several pixels wide, which is how the path itself becomes visible to a pixel test.
hints: fillPolygon and drawPolyline take the same (int[] xs, int[] ys, int count) arguments.
Set the stroke before drawPolyline; it does not affect the earlier fillPolygon.
drawPolyline leaves the shape open -- do not add a fourth point to close it.
